purpose: Teach: デリー/サウジアラビア/ユナイテッド/ダライ/家康/ジュネーブ/トロイ/台北

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、デリーへの留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, so your customer studied abroad in Delhi, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm, musing tone. Gentle curiosity about this customer. Conversational, unhurried. The affection of someone noticing details about people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サウジアラビアで駐在されてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer was stationed in Saudi Arabia, weren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective continuation. Light, interested. Building a picture of someone together. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのサポーターだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and your customer's a Manchester United supporter?
lines.style: Gentle surprise threaded through. Eyes lighting up at the discovery. Slight lift on the question. Still warm, still conversational.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ダライ・ラマの教えを学んでらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they're studying the teachings of the Dalai Lama, aren't they?
lines.style: Softer now, respectful reverence entering the tone. Slowing down slightly. The voice of someone recognizing depth in another person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、徳川家康の歴史小説がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and they love reading historical novels about Tokugawa Ieyasu?
lines.style: Warmth returning, almost playful now. A small laugh beneath the words. Delight in the specificity of tastes. Conversational and intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジュネーブのWHOで働いてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer used to work for the WHO in Geneva?
lines.style: Impression deepening now. Slight awe in the undertone, but grounded. Not performing amazement — genuine respect. Measured, warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トロイ遺跡の発掘団に参加されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they participated in excavations at Troy?
lines.style: Voice catching slightly with admiration. Leaning in a little. The wonder of someone piecing together a remarkable life. Quiet and sincere.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、台北の夜市が忘れられないって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and they can't forget the night markets in Taipei?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy now. Trailing off gently as if seeing the memory through their eyes. Tender, intimate, closing softly. The voice of someone who loves someone who loves travel.
